about: A fresh held-out set of 12 hard problems, written 30 Sep 2026 AFTER the hard set's holdout had been looked at (so that one no longer counts as unseen) and BEFORE any version was run on these. Every answer was checked by brute force or exact arithmetic (the race puzzle needed a fifth clue to have one solution). Nothing may be tuned on this set; it only judges v1, v2 and v3.

tasks.prompt: Pencils are 3 for $1.20 and erasers are 2 for $0.90. I buy 7 pencils and 5 erasers at the same price per item. How much do I pay, to the cent?
A bus leaves every 18 minutes, starting at 6:40 am. What time is the first bus after 9:00 am?
In a class of 30 students, 18 play soccer, 12 play badminton and 5 play both. How many students play neither?
My phone battery is at 80% and drops 6% every 25 minutes. How many minutes until it reaches 20%?
What is the smallest whole number that leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6, and is divisible by 7?
A recipe for 4 people uses 300 g of flour. I'm cooking for 10 people and already have 450 g of flour. How many more grams do I need?
March 1, 2027 is a Monday. What day of the week is June 1, 2027?
Three friends share a $52.50 bill. Ana pays $17.10 and the other two split the rest equally. How much does each of the other two pay?

Four runners - Zoe, Yan, Xia and Wes - finish a race in places 1 to 4. Zoe finishes before Yan. Xia finishes right after Zoe. Wes is not last. Yan is not 2nd. Zoe does not win. What place does each runner finish in?
A pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and a drain empties it in 10 hours. If both are open, how many hours does it take to fill the empty tank?
What is the sum of all whole numbers from 1 to 200 that are divisible by 3 or by 5?
I save $15 in the first week, and each week I save $3 more than the week before. How much have I saved in total after 10 weeks?
